description: List the videos in one tab of the user's SpyWinAds account (only videos the user's own app found). Each video: product line from the ad, the day the video file first appeared on Facebook (or first ad if unknown), age in days, live ads, total ads seen, stores running it now, first ad date, landing page. Max 50 per call.

max_age_days.description: Only videos whose file / first ad is at most this many days old

min_stores.description: Only videos run by at least this many stores now

tab.description: win, potential, scale, cash_cow, followed, testing, deep_dig or all

name: spywin_list_my_videos
title: My videos by tab
